text: Lesson 16 explained why this source needs a Python script. This lesson writes the real thing, start to finish: read, clean, connect, and load.
read_and_clean uses pandas to load the CSV, drop rows missing required columns, and fix types — converting sent_at to a real datetime and opened to a real boolean, before anything touches Snowflake.

load_to_snowflake opens a real connection with snowflake-connector-python, using the same transformer role and transforming warehouse Chapter 2 already built, then loads every cleaned row in one batch call with executemany.
This script reuses the existing transformer role instead of inventing a new one, keeping the RBAC story from Chapter 2 simple — one role writing raw and transformed data across the whole platform.

Confirming the load worked means querying raw_campaign_sends directly in Snowflake, the same verification habit from Lesson 4. Next: making this script run unattended, with real logging and a real schedule.
